generationPromptZh: 一个带床框、分区床垫及直线端板的四脚床。它由床框、床头板、床尾板、床垫和四脚组成。腿宽约为框宽的0.20倍，四脚向上面连接承重框。宽深比约0.53，高/最大水平跨度约0.79；支脚分置承重框四角，横向腿隙与框宽比0.40。实测采用4种不透明颜色，床框以棕色为主，床垫呈乳黄色。床垫分段2块。正视看前侧轮廓，侧视看纵深及附件连接，俯视看水平排列和间距；斜视同时显示前面、右侧与顶部，孔隙与接合均来自实体几何。 采用彩色体素。坐标为0至47的整数，X左右、Y向上、Z前后；实际接地最低Y为0。占用750至1250个唯一体素，RGB为0至255整数；保持单一六邻域连通、真实开口及面连接。不要添加展示底板、文字、背景、噪声或悬浮装饰。 原始参数规格：{"backSlatCount": 2, "baseWidthFraction": 0.47000000000000003, "category": "bed", "changedAttributes": ["width", "depth", "height", "supportInset", "shapeChamfer", "featureCount", "neck aperture ratio", "functional rim projection", "base taper", "support cross section", "functional part position"], "construction": "original continuous boxes and chamfered cross sections", "deckPositionRatio": 0.27, "depth": 22.0, "detailPosition": 0.25, "featureCount": 2, "handleThickness": 3.2, "height": 10.0, "instance": 0, "lensHeightRatio": 0.42, "lipOverhang": 0.4, "neckFraction": 0.35, "ordinal": 41901, "redesign": 0, "replanPhase": 1, "rimHeight": 2.0, "seamWidth": 2.2, "seatBoardCount": 2, "shapeChamfer": 0.0, "shoulderFraction": 0.5399999999999999, "sofaCushionCount": 2, "structureIndex": 0, "style": 0, "supportInset": 1.0, "supportThickness": 3.2, "towerMiddleWidthFraction": 0.8150000000000001, "towerTopWidthFraction": 0.6050000000000001, "variant": 1, "wallThickness": 2.0, "width": 12.0}
generationPromptEn: A four leg bed with a frame, segmented mattress and straight end boards. It includes a frame, headboard, footboard, mattress and four legs. Legs are 0.20 frame-widths thick and connect upward to the frame. Width/depth is 0.53; height/horizontal-span is 0.79. The supports occupy four separated corner positions. Leg-gap/width is 0.40. Across 4 opaque colors, the frame is mainly brown and the mattress is cream. There are 2 mattress sections. Front and side views expose contours and attachment joins; top and oblique views reveal spacing and upper surfaces. Use colored voxels at unique integer coordinates from 0 through 47, with X left to right, Y upward and Z front to back. Real ground contact starts at Y zero. Use 750 through 1250 occupied voxels and integer RGB values from 0 through 255. Keep one six neighbor component, real openings and face connected parts. Add no display base, text, background, noise or floating ornaments.
